messages.subject: Something deletes cached images
parts:
I run the following very basic RMD file:

---
output: html_document
---

```{r, cache=TRUE}
a <- 2
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE}
plot(rnorm(1e5), rnorm(1e5))
```

When I run this first time it runs perfectly. But second time it tries to locate the cached images and it fails. Because something deletes them. After pressing the "knit HTML" in Rstudio, I watch the folder contents in another window, The folder "trial1_files" created and mysteriously deleted just after the html file produced (when I run it first time). Later, when I knit it again, it gives an error because it cannot locate the deleted folder. 

This is weird. The cache functionality run without error in Latex documents. I cannot come up with an explanation. Any help will be appreciated. 

Here is the error:

  |................                                                 |  25%
  ordinary text without R code


  |................................                                 |  50%
label: unnamed-chunk-1 (with options)
List of 1
 $ cache: logi TRUE


  |.................................................                |  75%
  ordinary text without R code


  |.................................................................| 100%
label: unnamed-chunk-2 (with options)
List of 2
 $ echo :


processing file: trial1.Rmd
 logi FALSE
 $ cache: logi TRUE

output file: trial1.knit.md

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Something deletes cached images
parts:
Looks like a bug that has been fixed in rmarkdown, although I have no
idea when or how it was fixed. Anyway, please try

update.packages(ask = FALSE)
devtools::install_github('rstudio/rmarkdown')

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
